title: Trump announces "AI Force" and plans for an "AI czar" as he pushes unchecked AI growth
summary: Trump announces an "AI Force" modeled after the Space Force and plans to appoint an "AI czar" with a "high IQ." He claims AI could reach 25 percent of US economic output, rejects new regulation, and frames criticism of data centers as a left-wing attack.
